description: This file defines a C# class 'Route' used for JavaScript interop in a Blazor application. It provides a method to invoke a JavaScript function to change routes or navigate outside the app.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A class facilitating JavaScript interop for routing in a Blazor application.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to change the application's route or navigate externally.
